title: Windsor Castle ~$41 vs the Forbidden City ~$6 in Winter | China Travel Expert
description:
Two former royal palaces you can walk straight through today — and a wild price gap. Windsor Castle, still an official residence of the British monarch, charges about £32 for an adult ticket booked online (roughly $41). Beijing's Forbidden City, the old imperial palace that's now the Palace Museum, costs just ¥40 for standard admission in the winter low season from 1 November to 31 March (roughly $6).

That's about seven times cheaper to walk through the larger of the two palaces.

★ Expert Tip: Forbidden City tickets are released online seven days ahead at 20:00 Beijing time and there are no same-day sales at the gate — book early, and go in winter when it's ¥40 instead of the ¥60 peak price.

温莎城堡成人网络票约 £32（约 $41）；故宫淡季（11/1–3/31）普通票仅 ¥40（约 $6），相差约七倍。两座都是可以走进去参观的皇家宫殿。
